criteria.name: Written communication with customers
criteria.description: Evidence of writing clear, kind answers to customers.

anchors.1: Has seen writing clear, kind answers to customers done but has not done it alone.
anchors.3: Has done writing clear, kind answers to customers independently and can give a clear example.
anchors.5: Has led writing clear, kind answers to customers, can show a measured result and has taught others.

criteria.question: Tell me about a written answer to a customer that you are proud of. What did the customer need, what did you write, and what happened next?
